messages:
Elaine R.: starting canary rollout for model-serving v3.4.1 -> eu-west-1 canary (12% traffic). Pin: 3.4.1-canary. Watch p95 and 5xx for 15m. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd123/canary-slos and deploy log: https://ci.redwood/builds/rl-5421

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout_id=rl-5421, step=shift-12%, expected finish ~30m. Canary flags: kv-cache=on, small-batch-mode. CLI: `redwoodctl rollout status rl-5421`

Jordan: on it, watching the SLO dash and alerts. ping me if we hit thresholds.

Sam K.: brief thresholds reminder: p95 > 250ms OR 5xx_rate > 0.5% => auto-pause + manual rollback option. also watch GPU mem and node CPU.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] 2521112260 - anomaly detected: metric=canary.model-serving.eu-west.p95 value=310ms (baseline 140ms). 5xx_rate=0.13%. Correlation score with /v1/embed traffic: high.

Elaine R.: pausing traffic shift. @deploy-bot pause-rollout rl-5421

deploy-bot: Actioned: Rollout rl-5421 paused at 12% traffic. Paused by Elaine R. Current traffic: 12%. See: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/rl-5421

Jordan: pulling a quick snapshot from the dashboard and traces: ```p95_eu-west: 5m avg=310ms -> now=190ms
5xx_rate: 5m=0.13% -> now=0.02%
node-pool-a CPU: 78% -> 82%
gpu_mem_used: 89% (one pod at 94%)
spans show tail latencies in embed encoder warmup```

Sam K.: looks like the embed path is the culprit. Suggest partial pin: pin /v1/embed to 3.4.0 while leaving other routes on 3.4.1-canary. @deploy-bot pin-route /v1/embed 3.4.0 --region eu-west-1

deploy-bot: Route change applied: /v1/embed pinned -> 3.4.0 in eu-west-1. Routing table updated, traffic rules propagated (~12s).

oncall-bot: [INFO] 2521112320 - post-pin metrics: canary.model-serving.eu-west.p95=190ms, 5xx_rate=0.02%, embed_route_latency median down 40%.

Elaine R.: good. keep rollout paused at 12%. Sam, can you open an RCA ticket + attach traces? Jordan, please add a note to the change window log. I'll add a short entry to the release notes: "canary paused at 12%; partial pin on /v1/embed due to p95 spike".

Sam K.: filing ticket now: INC-5832 - "canary p95 spike traced to embed encoder - pin applied". attaching spans and metrics. ETA for initial triage 1h.

Jordan: added change-window note: "2521112223 - canary pause at 12% due to p95 spike; partial pin /v1/embed -> 3.4.0. Monitoring until stable."

Elaine R.: thanks team. :thumbsup: I'll only resume the rollout if p95 stays <240ms and 5xx <0.1% for 20m. Closing thread when metrics stable or rollback executed.
